quest.title: We Meet Again, Cannon...
quest.description: After hearing the sound of "cro-cro~~KOOM" by chance, you and Paimon discover an engineer who seems to be tinkering with a very unusual device...
quest.rewards_formatted: Primogem x20, Mora x10000, Adventurer's Experience x4

talks.objective: Find where the sound of the cannon is coming from

dialogues.text: Reducing the power to this level should be sufficient, the bubbleballs will be able to break the targets, an excellent balance of entertainment and safety...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Bubbleballs? Entertainment? Oh, so it's a toy water cannon! That's a relief...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Though... Doesn't this water cannon look familiar? Have we... seen it somewhere before?

choices.text: I don't really recall, so let's just say it's our first time seeing it.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Maybe it's because its shape is so unusual, it looks like a Spinocrocodile... The moment Paimon sees it, she just wants to give it a nickname like "Crococannon"...
Crococannon? The name's not bad! "Croco" is almost like... the sound of cannonballs! Concise, easy to understand, and memorable... I think it's an excellent suggestion!
Looks like you two are interested in this watercannon! How would you like to be my first guests?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh! Paimon thinks she can guess what you're gonna say next—

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: You've just finished making adjustments to the watercannon, and were just planning to find some people to test it out and give you some feedback?
Absolutely and completely correct! You guys are the real deal, you must have worked together with many in the past. I anticipate no difficulties in cooperating with you!

response.speaker: Brest
response.text: Allow me to introduce myself. My name is Brest, and I am a former naval artillery engineer from the Fontaine Research Institute's armaments research team, currently unemployed.

response.speaker: Brest
response.text: In order to make a living, I've been fiddling with this "Improved Crocomorph Vortex-Based Crocodilian-Armored Heavy Naval Battleship-Style Recreational Water Blasting Cannon" in the hopes of opening a water park...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Waitasec, a naval artillery engineer... unemployed... a water park? Paimon's brain is swimming in a sea of confusion...

choices.text: You must've been through quite a bit...

response.speaker: Brest
response.text: No choice, really, times have changed. Fontaine once had an impressive armada, and back then, naval cannons were a non-negotiable requirement. But after a massive battle, the fleet was utterly annihilated...

response.speaker: Brest
response.text: Fontaine is now a nation of clockwork meka, and the Palais Mermonia has no plans to rebuild the fleet. Naval artillery is expensive, large, and heavy, and there's currently no real use for them... nor for someone like me, who likes to tinker with them...

response.speaker: Brest
response.text: In any case, military contracting is a dead end, so I've got to consider switching to another industry completely. After all, no matter how you slice it, you've gotta live! Being happy is the important thing.

response.speaker: Brest
response.text: Opening a water park, earning some money from ticket sales, living an ordinary, peaceful life... not that bad, really...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Should... Should Paimon say you're really the glass-half-full type? Doesn't seem like you need to be consoled at all...

response.speaker: Brest
response.text: Anyway, let's not talk about sad stuff like that now, let's talk about my Improved Crococannon! It's really super fun!

response.speaker: Brest
response.text: Based on the blueprints left behind by Monsieur Chatillon, I've made a few targeted optimizations. The new model no longer requires loading, and can even switch between ammunition types!

response.speaker: Brest
response.text: I've also added more targets and stage designs to make the attraction even more challenging! I've been playing for three days, and I'm still not tired of it!

response.speaker: Brest
response.text: After you start playing, you'll be able to forget about all your problems, and just lose yourself in the fun! If you're satisfied, then help me spread the word about it!

choices.text: Then we won't mention anything about work or unemployment.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Say no more, Paimon wants to play!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Ms. Brest is right, we did work together really well! Paimon hopes that... when other people run into rough patches, they can have that same great attitude she does!

choices.text: Then let's try out this new Crococannon.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: That's right! Paimon remembers now, we saw the Crococannon back in the Veluriyam Mirage! But the person operating it... doesn't look like Mr. Chatillon?
Monsieur Chatillon!? You know of the legendary watercannon designer Chatillon!? ...That means you two must truly be experts in the field!
Looks like you and this watercannon have quite the connection! How would you like to be my first guests?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh? It sounds like something exploded... Is there a fight happening nearby?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hmm? It seems like it came from that direction. Come on!
